result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual cap at the greater of USD 1,000,000 and 12 months’ charges paid or payable, retains a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, and states that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The targeted data-loss exception is necessary to avoid undermining the confidentiality and data-security carve-outs. Unrelated commercial intent is preserved. Drafting quality is reduced by inconsistent cross-references to Sections 9 and 10 and by retaining the broader payment proviso covering services that would have been rendered but for breach; these should be reconciled to avoid ambiguity.
